name: OSATS-inspired rubric (Objective Structured Assessment of Technical Skills, Martin et al. 1997, adapted)

scale.note: Anchors defined at 1, 3 and 5; 2 and 4 are between. Letter grade from the mean.

anchors.1: Frequent or unnecessary force; repeated damage to tissue
anchors.3: Careful handling but occasional inadvertent damage
anchors.5: Consistently gentle; minimal or no damage

anchors.3: Efficient most of the time, some wasted motion
anchors.5: Economy of movement and maximum efficiency

anchors.1: Repeatedly makes tentative or awkward moves
anchors.3: Competent use but occasionally stiff or awkward
anchors.5: Fluid, confident moves with no awkwardness

anchors.1: Frequently stopped and unsure of the next move
anchors.3: Demonstrates some forward planning with reasonable progression
anchors.5: Obviously planned course; smooth, uninterrupted progress

anchors.1: Large, repeated misses of the target
anchors.3: Usually on target, with some corrections
anchors.5: Consistently on target, no corrections needed

grades.label: E
grades.text: Novice: slow down and try again

mapping._note: Each rule: metric key, units, and thresholds. Score 5 if value <= t5, 4 if <= t4, 3 if <= t3, 2 if <= t2, else 1 (lower is better). Metric names are suggestions; LEVELS may rename and tell CONTENT via docs/NOTES.md.

instrument.unit: mm mean drift off needle arc
